manual_notes: PR118 implements MCP editMethod, comment-aware unambiguous boundary scanning, source splicing and standard transport/lock/PUT/unlock flow. The recorded spec names adt source write --method, but pinned CLI registers source put with no write alias; the splice also rebuilds METHOD/ENDMETHOD lines rather than preserving the existing boundary lines. Delivery is substantial, but these contract differences leave strict completion unclear, not abandoned.
